about: Blast-radius model of the porter-blast-radius connector itself. Tested by test/connector-model.test.mjs; the hygiene test enforces the absent edges (no exec, no network, no writes).

C-ROOTS.mechanism: fsguard.confine: real paths only, inside the allowed roots; directory walks never follow symlinks.

C-ARGS.mechanism: Strict argument validation: unknown keys, wrong types and out-of-range values are rejected before any handler runs.

C-NO-EXEC.mechanism: Git facts come from reading .git files; the code imports no child_process, so neither repository content nor tool arguments can run a program.

C-SANITIZE.mechanism: Every output string has control and bidi characters stripped and is length-capped; server instructions tell the client that model text is data.

C-ID-REGEX.mechanism: Discovered ids, types and effects must match strict patterns; names and notes are cleaned and capped.

C-CRED-STRIP.mechanism: Remote URLs are reduced to host/owner/repo, dropping credentials; free-text notes from porter.json are passed through, capped.

C-BOUNDED.mechanism: Size caps on every read (2 MB models, 1 MB manifests), bounded walks, skipped files become warnings.

C-FAIL-LOUD.mechanism: Handler errors become isError results with actionable text; a missing runtime shows as a failed server in /mcp.

C-OUTPUT-BUDGET.mechanism: Results shrink array by array to fit 30,000 chars and say they were truncated.

C-MODEL-CHECK.mechanism: Analysis tools refuse models that fail validation; the skill requires check_model and says absence from a result is not safety.

C-TESTS.mechanism: One engine shared by the connector and the design-doc tool, covered by both test suites.

C-VALIDATE.mechanism: claude plugin validate --strict on the plugin and the marketplace.

failureModes.title: Hostile repo text (names, notes) carries instructions into the agent's context
Agent-supplied path reads files outside the allowed roots
Scanning a hostile repo runs code through git config (core.fsmonitor and similar)
Huge or malformed manifest stalls or crashes the server
A radius from an incomplete model is read as 'safe'
Oversized result is silently cut by the client
Credentials embedded in remote URLs leak into tool output
An engine change breaks the connector and the design docs differently
